get.summary: Report that the API process is serving requests.
List the caller's own diaries, newest date first, one page per `before` date.

post.summary: Open the caller's diary for today in the given time zone, or for a past date, creating it if missing.

get.summary: Open one of the caller's diaries: its current text, generation and seq.
Look up the caller's committed batch by batch ID or by one operation ID.
List history points of a diary, newest first, one page per opaque cursor.
Read one committed version as server-rendered, read-only author runs.
The caller's own read coverage of a diary they may read, merged across devices.

post.summary: Add characters the caller saw on screen to their own read coverage; no one else ever learns of it.

get.summary: Open the partner's diary shared with the caller as one epoch: live, or frozen at the version sharing stopped.
Who wrote one visible character and when, in the text the caller may read.
The partner's diaries shared with the caller in a space, live or frozen, newest date first.
List the dates with the caller's own or the partner's shared diary, newest first, with list unread marks.
One date's own and shared diaries, as on the day list.
The caller's current binding and their latest open invitation.
Spaces the caller takes part in, current or archived.
One space the caller takes part in, with its binding periods. No sharing range.

post.summary: Open a seven-day invitation link, closing the caller's previous one; a repeated requestId returns it without its token.
Revoke one of the caller's invitations; revoking it again changes nothing.
Show who invited the caller and whether it starts or restores a space; binds nothing.
Bind the caller to the inviter, storing each confirmed sharing range and opening that person's covered diaries to the other.
End the given binding period for both participants; the space and its history stay.

get.summary: The caller's own sharing range in a space; never the partner's.

put.summary: Confirm the caller's sharing range for the open period, opening covered diaries to the partner and freezing ones no longer covered.
